name: SchoolBoy OutDoors
detailed_description:
You’re a schoolboy who ran away from home just to hang out… But this is only the beginning!

After a bold escape, you’re about to dive into a real childhood summer — full of freedom, mischief, and adventures. Explore streets, backyards, and abandoned places with your friends. Hide from nosy neighbors, solve puzzles, and try not to get spotted by your parents — they’re still looking for you!

Ready for fun, trouble… and something a little scarier?

What started as innocent games quickly turns into something more — someone shares a creepy story, someone else dares you to sneak into the old house… All you wanted was to play some football.

Key Features:

• First-person 3D gameplay

• Stealth, mini-quests, and street puzzles

• Backyard childhood atmosphere with a touch of mystery and horror

short_description: You’re a schoolboy who ran away from home to hang out — but this is only the beginning! Summer, friends, backyard mischief… and mysteries hiding something much darker. Explore the streets, avoid adults, and uncover a secret you were better off not knowing.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game presents a story of a strict and abusive family environment. The father is depicted as being intoxicated with a beer bottle, while the parents engage in harsh treatment of their son. Punishments include forcing the child to perform physical exercises, as well as physical abuse such as whipping with a belt and slapping.

Mature content, such as the parents’ abusive behavior toward their child, is depicted in specific scenes and during interactions between the child and the parents throughout the storyline.
